title: Member access onboarding + sandbox preview wizard with audit-log snapshot
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a stepped onboarding wizard for assigning roles to new and existing members that includes: 1) guided SSO group sync and suggested role mappings, 2) temporary sandbox access option (time-boxed elevation) with clear expiration and auto-audit snapshot, and 3) an inline audit-log preview that shows what events will be recorded if the assignment is committed. This is part of RBAC v2 work to reduce helpdesk escalations, limit blast radius for new members, and make audit trails explicit at time of change.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard screens for: select members (individual + CSV bulk), pick or create role, set time-bound sandbox window, review audit snapshot, confirm commit
SSO group sync step displays detected groups and suggests role mappings with confidence scores; a user can accept or override suggestions
Temporary sandbox access must attach metadata for audit (granted_by, start_time, end_time, justification) visible in preview
Audit-log preview lists the discrete audit events (role_assignment.created, role_assignment.temp_grant, notification.sent) that will be emitted with mock timestamps
Design includes fallback flows: when SSO sync fails, when user tries to assign a higher-privilege role without 2FA or manager approval
Mobile-responsive components for the drawer-based flow and accessible keyboard/aria support
Figma mocks and redlines delivered; front-end handoff tokens and example API payloads included
ux_flow_steps: Step 1: Identity selection - pick individuals, invite via email, or upload CSV
Step 2: SSO group sync - detect user's SSO groups, show suggested mappings and confidence (high/medium/low)
Step 3: Role selection - choose from templates or custom role composer quick picker
Step 4: Sandbox window - optional time-bound elevation with start/end and auto-recall policy
Step 5: Audit snapshot - inline list of audit events and example dashboard entry that will be created
Step 6: Review & commit - summary, mandatory justification if elevating to P0 role, confirmation email toggle
mock_review_feedback: PM (Jordan Lee): prefer clearer callout for 'auto-recall' behavior; add a tiny info tooltip explaining what happens if the host is offline
Security (Maya Chen): require justification field mandatory for P0/P1 temp grants and mark in audit events; flag retention policy for snapshots
Engineering (Diego Alvarez): suggested adding a compact API example for bulk CSV flow and expected error codes; flagged that SSO group suggestions should include last-sync timestamp
Design review (Lina Park): reduced visual noise on audit snapshot by collapsing low-impact events, added 'show all' link
engineering_notes: Add API contract: POST /v1/orgs/{org}/roles/assignments with fields: users[], role_id, temp_grant:{start,end,reason}, audit_snapshot:true
Frontend: implement as right-hand drawer with progressive steps; reuse existing role-composer components
Backend: emit audit events with explicit event_type and metadata, and store snapshot_id for later reference in console
Edge case: SSO group sync failures should not block commit but require a confirmation checkbox and create an audit flag
qa_checks: CSV bulk: upload malformed CSV and validate user-facing error message matches spec
Temporary grant expiry: verify auto-revoke runs at boundary times and logs both revoke and revoke_result events
Audit preview accuracy: confirm that the previewed events match the events emitted in a test org
Accessibility: keyboard navigation through wizard, screen reader labels present for each step
